website.note: No proprietary drug pipeline page; product pages cover commercial cfDNA/genetic tests (Signatera, Panorama, Horizon, Prospera, Empower, Altera). Pipeline URL returned only an SVG graphic.

ctgov.note: All studies are investigator/cooperative-group sponsored using Natera's Signatera ctDNA assay as a biomarker/monitoring tool, not Natera-sponsored therapeutic trials.

commercial_product.summary: Natera markets molecular diagnostics: Signatera (personalized ctDNA MRD), Panorama (NIPT), Horizon (carrier screening), Prospera (transplant rejection cfDNA), Empower (hereditary cancer), Altera (tumor genomic profiling), Renasight (kidney genetics).

excluded_partner_owned: All ctgov entries listing Natera as collaborator — investigator/co-op-group sponsored studies that use Signatera as a monitoring biomarker rather than Natera-sponsored therapeutic assets.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Diagnostics / lab-services company — no proprietary therapeutic drug or device clinical pipeline. Natera develops and commercializes cell-free DNA (cfDNA) molecular diagnostic tests; clinical studies on ClinicalTrials.gov are investigator- or cooperative-group-sponsored studies that use Natera's Signatera ctDNA assay as a biomarker.
